# Link preview

1 route. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/api/v1/link-preview` | Read Open Graph metadata for a URL |

### POST /api/v1/link-preview

Read Open Graph metadata for a URL

Fetches a public URL and returns its Open Graph / Twitter card metadata for rendering a link preview. Private, loopback and non-HTTP addresses are rejected.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `url`: string (uri), required

**Responses**

- `200` — Metadata for the URL
  - object
    - `preview`: `LinkPreview`, required
      - `url`: string, required — The URL the metadata was read from, after redirects — may differ from the requested one.
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `description`: string | null, required
      - `image`: string | null, required
      - `siteName`: string | null, required
      - `type`: one of `"video"` | `"article"`, required — `video` when the page advertises video content (og:type, a Twitter player card, or a known video host), `article` otherwise. Drives the player-card layout in the composer.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
